title: Second Thought: Reasoning in Parallel as LLM Agents Act and Observe
abstract: arXiv:2608.13667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents in the ReAct paradigm alternate between reasoning, acting, and observing, but deliberate reasoning is confined to the Thought phase: while the agent serializes an action and waits for the environment, its reasoning is frozen. We identify this recurring interval for Action and Observation as a reasoning idle window and ask whether it can host additional reasoning in parallel that serves future turns. Therefore, we propose Second Thought, a training-free inference framework that forks four auxiliary branches the instant each Thought phase concludes, decodes them concurrently with the main loop, and merges the generated thoughts back when the environment observation arrives. In this way, Second Thought relocates the added reasoning off the main thread's sequential decoding path. translated_title: 第二思考：LLM代理在行动与观察时并行推理
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13667v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在ReAct范式中的LLM代理交替进行推理、行动和观察，但深思熟虑的推理仅限于思考阶段：当代理序列化一个行动并等待环境时，其推理是冻结的。我们将行动和观察的这一反复出现的间隔识别为推理空闲窗口，并询问它是否能承载额外的并行推理，以服务于未来的回合。因此，我们提出了第二思考（Second Thought），一个无需训练的推理框架，它在每个思考阶段结束时立即分叉出四个辅助分支，与主循环并发解码，并在环境观察到达时合并生成的思考。这样，第二思考将额外的推理移出主线程的顺序解码路径。在三个代理基准测试和三个推理LLM上，第二思考在所有九个（模型，基准）对中降低了平均回合数，并减少了主...
tldr: 第二思考提出了一种无需训练的推理框架，通过在行动和观察期间并行运行辅助推理分支，有效利用推理空闲窗口，减少代理任务中的回合数并提升效率。
en_tdlr: Second Thought proposes a training-free inference framework that runs auxiliary reasoning branches in parallel during action and observation, effectively utilizing the reasoning idle window to reduce turn counts and improve efficiency in agent tasks.
